products.name: Paradox (Olivia)
products.note: Conversational recruiting AI; candidate screening; automated scheduling; hiring bias risk

profile_text.body:
Paradox is a software company focused on recruiting and hiring automation. The company describes itself as offering conversational hiring software designed to automate tasks such as candidate screening, interview scheduling, and onboarding, with the stated goal of moving candidates through the hiring process more quickly and with less manual effort.

The company's primary AI product is an assistant called Olivia, which handles recruiting tasks conversationally so that hiring teams spend less time on administrative work. Paradox states that it pledges to use AI only in ways that have been thoroughly vetted and that comply with principles of transparency, explainability, fairness, accountability, security, and safety. The site's tracked product entry also notes that Olivia carries a hiring bias risk consideration alongside its screening and scheduling capabilities.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data for this company.
